summary:
During this internship, I learned and upskilled Python programming with a focus on Object Oriented Programming (OOP).
With this knowledge, I created a Text Analysis Project. In this project, I performed various tasks on textual data, like breaking it into words (tokenization), reducing words to their base form (stemming), removing common words (stop words), counting word occurrences and many more things.
I also got introduced to the basics of Django, a web development framework.
Using this newfound knowledge, I independently developed a Tic Tac Toe Game using the Django Framework.
This internship enhanced my programming skills and problem-solving abilities, setting the stage for a promising future in software development.

During my internship, I was engaged in a dynamic role where I collected data from diverse sources, with a particular focus on managing data stored in buckets from GCP. This involved not only gathering the information but also applying effective tagging techniques to organise the necessary data from the unstructured data.
Furthermore, I was responsible for the crucial task of data cleaning, removing the unnecessary, irrelevant or redundant data.
This process ensured that we were working with high quality and relevant data sets. One of the most exciting aspects of my internship was my involvement in a sports project.
This experience allowed me to immerse myself into the field of sports data analytics and data management where timing and accuracy were key parameters.
This role required me to collaborate seamlessly with the team, honing my communication skills and ensuring that our efforts were synchronised and aligned with the fast paced nature of sports analytics.
Overall, my internship was an incredibly valuable and enriching experience that significantly enhanced my skills in data collection, organization, and communication.
